  <p class="synopsis">墟境异动，秩序校准仪告警。太阴月神自昆仑洞天月神殿苏醒，持天书负剑，踏入墟境裂隙。天书展开，玄鸟图腾自书页飞出，剑光如月轮斩破混沌。墟境启封，秩序归位，月神立于墟境之巅，霞光万丈。</p>
</div>

<div class="section">
  <div class="section-title">分 镜 概 览</div>
  <ul class="storyboard-list">
    <li>
      <div class="sb-time">0-3s</div>
      <div class="sb-content"><strong>月神殿苏醒</strong>昆仑洞天月神殿，月轮浮雕，月光倾泻。月神盘膝坐于月轮之下。</div>
    </li>
    <li>
      <div class="sb-time">3-7s</div>
      <div class="sb-content"><strong>天书启封</strong>月神睁眼，瞳孔如满月。天书自动翻开，玄鸟图腾流动，剑鞘微颤。</div>
    </li>
    <li>
      <div class="sb-time">7-10s</div>
      <div class="sb-content"><strong>步入墟境</strong>月神起身，长发飞扬，转身走向殿外墟境裂隙。天书悬浮，剑出鞘半寸。</div>
    </li>
    <li>
      <div class="sb-time">10-14s</div>
      <div class="sb-content"><strong>墟境裂隙</strong>混沌翻滚，空间扭曲。月神立于裂隙前，身影孤绝，青黑长裙猎猎。</div>
    </li>
    <li>
      <div class="sb-time">14-17s</div>
      <div class="sb-content"><strong>玄鸟为引</strong>天书完全展开，金光流转。玄鸟图腾飞出化为虚影盘旋，剑已出鞘。</div>
    </li>
    <li>
      <div class="sb-time">17-20s</div>
      <div class="sb-content"><strong>月轮凝聚</strong>举剑，剑光凝聚为巨大月轮。玄鸟虚影融入月轮，能量凝聚。</div>
    </li>
    <li>
      <div class="sb-time">20-24s</div>
      <div class="sb-content"><strong>月轮斩混沌</strong>月轮斩出，横切混沌。玄鸟伴随剑光飞掠，混沌退散，秩序归位。</div>
    </li>
    <li>
      <div class="sb-time">24-27s</div>
      <div class="sb-content"><strong>墟境启封</strong>混沌消散，悬浮岛屿、古建遗迹、星光流转。月神立于墟境之巅，霞光万丈。</div>
    </li>
    <li>
      <div class="sb-time">27-30s</div>
      <div class="sb-content"><strong>秩序归位</strong>月神背影面向墟境全景。片名浮现，溯源符号镌刻。主题音乐收束。</div>
    </li>
  </ul>
</div>

<script>
  let currentSlide = 0;
  const slides = document.querySelectorAll('.hero-slide');
  setInterval(() => {
    slides[currentSlide].classList.remove('active');
    currentSlide = (currentSlide + 1) % slides.length;
    slides[currentSlide].classList.add('active');
  }, 4000);

  function openLightbox(card) {
    const img = card.querySelector('img');
    document.getElementById('lightbox-img').src = img.src;
    document.getElementById('lightbox').classList.add('active');
  }
  function closeLightbox() {
    document.getElementById('lightbox').classList.remove('active');
  }
</script>
